name: Heartbeat Vault
description: Savings the owner can always spend, that pass to an heir only after the owner has been silent for a set number of blocks. Each spend by the owner resets the clock.

resources.name: HandlePay
resources.description: The payments app this vault belongs to: pay people by name on Bitcoin Cash.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Puts money in the vault, and can take it out or check in at any time.

heir.name: Heir
heir.description: Can take the money only after the owner has been silent for the whole waiting period.

createVault.name: Create vault
createVault.description: The owner and the heir each make a key, and the owner locks money to both with a waiting period.

owner.name: Fund vault
owner.description: Make the owner key, choose the waiting period and the amount, and pay it in.

heir.name: Become heir
heir.description: Make the heir key so the vault can name you.

heartbeat.name: Check in
heartbeat.description: The owner moves the vault back into itself, which restarts the waiting period.

reclaim.name: Take money out
reclaim.description: The owner spends the vault to any address, with no waiting.

claim.name: Claim inheritance
claim.description: The heir takes the vault after the owner has been silent for the whole waiting period.

createVaultTransaction.name: Vault created
createVaultTransaction.description: $(<vaultSatoshis>) satoshis locked for the owner, passing to the heir after $(<timeoutBlocks>) silent blocks.

heartbeatTransaction.name: Owner checked in
heartbeatTransaction.description: The owner moved the vault back into itself, so the waiting period starts again.

claimTransaction.name: Heir claimed
claimTransaction.description: The heir claimed the vault after the waiting period.

ownerInput.name: Vault, spent by the owner
ownerInput.description: The owner signs; no waiting is needed.

heirInput.name: Vault, spent by the heir
heirInput.description: The heir signs, and the coin must have sat unspent for the whole waiting period.

vaultOutput.name: Vault
vaultOutput.description: $(<vaultSatoshis>) satoshis held for the owner and heir.

renewedVaultOutput.name: Vault
renewedVaultOutput.description: The same vault, with the waiting period started again.

payoutOutput.name: Payout
payoutOutput.description: The vault paid out, less the network fee.

vaultLockingScript.name: Heartbeat vault
vaultLockingScript.description: Owner can spend any time; heir can spend after the waiting period.

scripts.vaultRedeemBytecode: OP_IF <ownerKey.public_key> OP_CHECKSIG OP_ELSE enforceWaitingPeriod <heirKey.public_key> OP_CHECKSIG OP_ENDIF

minerFeeSatoshis.name: Network fee
minerFeeSatoshis.description: Satoshis left for the miner when the vault is spent.

timeoutBlocks.name: Waiting period (blocks)
timeoutBlocks.description: How many blocks the owner must be silent before the heir can claim. 6 is about an hour; 4,320 is about 30 days.

recipientLockingScript.name: Pay to
recipientLockingScript.description: Where the money goes when the vault is spent.
